title: Unsubscribe Compliance Check
one_line: Check that outbound campaigns carry a working unsubscribe path and that opt outs land somewhere that actually stops the next send.
description: Check that outbound campaigns carry a working unsubscribe path and that opt outs land somewhere that actually stops the next send. Use before launching, during a compliance review, or when someone asks what an outbound email legally needs.
paragraph: An unsubscribe link that renders is not an unsubscribe path. The path has three parts, and the one that breaks is always the third: the link, the confirmation, and the write that reaches the suppression layer before the next scheduled send. This skill tests all three end to end rather than checking that the footer exists.
keywords: do my emails need an unsubscribe
what does an outbound email legally need
approval_stop: sending a test email to any address you do not own

requirements.item: Access to your sending platform (Instantly, Smartlead or similar)
requirements.used_for: The campaign and its unsubscribe path
requirements.cost: None beyond your existing sending plan.

requirements.item: Seed inboxes at Gmail, Microsoft and Yahoo that you control, or an inbox placement test service
requirements.used_for: The end to end opt out test
requirements.cost: Free with your own seed inboxes; a placement test service bills you directly.
